book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Pol Rom nɨbi bɨ kalɨp köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨka

content: Pol, “Kale mɨdpim?” a ga
Pen añ hon Pibi, Senkria daun au cöc wög gab nɨbi u, nab. Nɨpe nɨbi aij yabɨƚ. Kale mɨdpim u amjakö, nɨp ud aij gɨmim.

Yɨp aij gɨnab u, kale mɨdpim u amjakö, kale Bɨ Kub nɨŋ udpim rö, Bɨ Kub nɨbi bɨ nɨpe pen pen ud aij gɨpal u rö, nɨp ud aij gɨmim. Nan rɨmnap mɨdagainɨm, haƚöwaƚö ñɨmim. Nɨpe nɨbi bɨ gau iru nöp kalɨp ud aij göm, yɨp abe ud aij göm göp.
Pen nɨbi Prisila abe, nugmul Akwila abe, Krais nɨp wög jɨm ñun gɨmɨdun ber mɨhau kalɨp hagmim, “Pol kalöp ber mɨhöŋ, ‘Mɨdpil?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.

Nöd yɨp al pak lɨnɨg geila, ber aij yad mɨhau mɨdmil, yɨp amdam gɨlö. Pen halpe ke al pak löl a gɨmil gasɨ u nɨŋagmil anɨg gɨlö, yɨp aij göm, Juda nɨbi bɨ wasö ram mɨnöŋ ke mɨlö gau hag ñɨnö Krais Jisas nɨŋ udpal gau kalɨp abe aij göm göp.

Pen nɨbi bɨ Krais Jisas nɨŋ udpal ram kalɨp ber u magum gɨpal gau kalɨp u rö nöp hagmim, “Pol kalöp, ‘Mɨdpim?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Mam mɨdmagö yad Epinidas nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Esia Propins au, Krais nɨp nöd uda bɨ me anɨbu.
Nɨbi Maria kalöp kƚö yabɨƚ wög gɨ ñɨmɨdöp u nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.

Pen bɨ rɨdɨk yad nɨŋeb rö, Adronaikas abe, Junias abe, kalɨp mɨhöŋ hagmim, “Pol kalöp mɨhöŋ, ‘Mɨdpil?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Kalpe mɨhöŋ Krais nɨp nöd nɨŋ udlö, yad hainö nɨŋ udnö. Yɨp nagɨ lɨla rö, kalɨp mɨhöŋ u rö nöp nagɨ lɨlö, jɨm ñun mɨdmɨdun. Pen bɨ Jisas manö ud arep gau, bɨ anɨb mɨhau kalɨp nɨŋ aij yabɨƚ gɨpal.
Mam mɨdmagö yad Ampliedas, Krais nɨp cɨg aij göp u, nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Mam Urbanɨs nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Mam anɨbu yad aip Krais nɨp wög jɨm ñöl gɨmɨdul. Mam aij Sɨdakis nɨp u rö nöp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.

Apeles, marö auö, Krais nɨp nɨŋ ud pɨdöŋ göm mɨd aij göp bɨ u, nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Nɨbi bɨ Arisdobiulas ram mɨdpal gau kalɨp hagmim, “Pol kalöp, ‘Mɨdpim?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Bɨ rɨdɨk yad nɨŋeb Herodion nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Nɨbi bɨ Nasisas ram u mɨdöm, Bɨ Kub nɨŋ udpal gau kalɨp hagmim, “Pol kalöp, ‘Mɨdpim?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.

Nɨbi Draipina abe Draiposa abe, Bɨ Kub nɨp nɨŋ udöl gɨ, nɨp wög gɨpil nɨbi anɨb mɨhau kalɨp hagmim, “Pol kalöp mɨhöŋ, ‘Mɨdpil?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Añ aij yad Persis, Bɨ Kub nɨp nɨŋ udöl gɨ, nɨp wög kƚö göp nɨbi anɨbu nɨp u rö nöp, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Bɨ Rupas, Krais nɨp wög kƚö göm göp u, nɨp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim. Nɨme nɨpe u, ami yad rö löp u, nɨp u rö nöp hagmim, “Pol nöp, ‘Mɨdpan?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Asinkridas, Pligon, Hermes, Padrobas, Hermas, nɨmam kale aip mɨdpal gau abe magöŋhalö kalɨp, “Pol kalöp, ‘Mɨdpim?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Pilologas, Julia, Nereus, Nereus nɨñɨn nɨpe Olimpas, Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe kale aip mɨdpal gau magöŋhalö, “Pol kalöp, ‘Mɨdpim?’ a göp,” a gɨmim.
Kale Bɨ Kub nɨp nɨŋ udpim rö, pen pen hag wɨhai udöl gɨ, alaun bom halumim. Krais nɨbi bɨ nɨpe gai i God nɨp sabe gɨnɨg cöc ke ke magum gɨpal gau, “Kale mɨdpim?” a gɨpal.
Manö piral hagpal gau udagmim

Añ mam aij yad gau, nɨŋ aij gɨmim. Nɨbi bɨ rɨmnap manö gau nɨbö gau nɨbö dapöm, nɨbi bɨ Krais lau adö mɨdpal gau kalɨp hag ñɨlö ñɨlö, gasɨ aij nöd nɨŋla adö u arö göm, manö piral hagpal anɨbu udöm, asɨk ke ke lɨbal. Kalöp anɨb unbö rö nöp gɨnɨm rö löp u, manö piral hagaiöl u udagmim.

Nɨbi bɨ anɨg gɨpal gau, Bɨ Kub hon Krais nɨp wög u gun, a göm gasɨ u nɨŋöm gagpal; kalɨp ke aij göp adö u nöp gasɨ nɨŋöm gɨpal. Kale manö hain hain rö, nɨbi bɨ hib dap raneb manö u nöp hag hag gɨ mɨdlö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨbi bɨ nɨŋ aij gagpal gau manö piral kale nɨŋ udöm dui gɨpal.

Kale pen God manö aij u ud aij gɨmim, hagöp rö gɨmɨdim, nɨbi bɨ gau magöŋhalö nɨŋbal u, yɨp aij yabɨƚ göp. Nan nɨhön God amgö ilö nɨpe aij gɨnɨm u, kale nɨbi bɨ gasɨ nɨŋeb rö mɨdmim, nan nɨhön God amgö ilö nɨpe nan si nan naij rö mɨdnɨm u, kale nɨbi bɨ gasɨ hauƚ rö mɨdmim u, yɨp aij gɨnab.
Söl mɨdöp, God nɨbi bɨ abad mɨd aij göp u, nɨpe Seden nɨp ud raƚa mo kale gau lö, kƚö nɨpe mɨdageinab. Yad God nɨp sabe gabin, Bɨ Kub hon Jisas kalöp mög nɨŋöm ud aij gö nɨŋöl gɨ, kale mɨd aij gɨmim.
Bɨ yad aip wög jɨm ñöl gɨpul, Dimodi, kalöp hagab, “Mɨdpim?” a gab. Bɨ rɨdɨk nɨŋeb yad gau Lusias, Jeson, Sosipada u rö nöp kalöp, “Mɨdpim?” a gaböl.
Pen yad bɨ Dedias, Pol hagö köp kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkabin i, u rö nöp kale Rom kai Krais lau adö mɨdpim gau kalöp, “Mɨdpim?” a gabin.

Bɨ Gaias, yɨp Pol dam ram nɨpe u löm, abad mɨd aij göp u, kalöp, “Mɨdpim?” a gab. Bɨ anɨbu nöp Krais lau adö mɨdpal nɨbi bɨ gau hagö, ram nɨpe u amöm magum gɨpal, kalɨp ud aij gɨ mɨdöp. Pen bɨ kuskus pe ñeb Erasdas abe, mam hon Kwodas abe, u rö nöp kalöp, “Mɨdpim?” a gabil.
Yad God nɨp sabe gabin, Bɨ Kub hon Jisas Krais kalöp magöŋhalö mög nɨŋöm ud aij gö nɨŋöl gɨ, kale mɨd aij gɨmim. Anɨb unbö rö aij!

Pen God hib nɨpe hagno adö arnɨm. Nɨpe nöp me kalöp abad mɨdö nɨŋöl gɨ, nɨp cɨg aij gɨmim mɨdmim rö löp. Jisas manö aij anɨbu nöd pi göl mɨdmɨdöp u pen mɨñi, bɨ God manö hagep gau, manö nɨpe God Manö kalɨ kƚiñ rɨkla u waiö lö, manö aij anɨbu nɨbi bɨ gau kalɨp pör hag ñɨbin. God nöp hagö me, nɨbi bɨ ram mɨnöŋ ke gau gau magöŋhalö hag ñɨno, nɨp nɨŋ udöm hagöp rö göl.
God añɨ gasɨ aij gasɨ kƚö göm nɨŋöb u, Jisas Krais nɨp hanɨp nan a göm yuö aua rö, hib nɨpe pör nöp pör nöp hagno adö araŋ. Anɨb unbö rö aij me.
